## Notes

Ndemic Creations, designer James Vaughan. iOS 2018-12-08, Android 2019-02-11, Windows and macOS as Rebel Inc: Escalation 2019-10-15. Stabilize a war-torn region against an insurgency; monthly budget for civilian initiatives and military spending; more initiatives raise corruption and inflation; governance tab; negotiated peace; governors such as the Economist and Warlord; regions inspired by Afghanistan; described as a spiritual sequel to Plague Inc.
